### Summary

* **PO-20417**: 800 pcs of TW-BTL-500 remain on schedule to ship on 10 October 2026.
* 1,200 pcs of TW-BTL-750 are delayed due to line maintenance, with the ready date pushed from 10 October to 24 October 2026.
* The supplier has requested confirmation of the new ready date and offered the option of a split shipment.

```json
{
  "supplier": "Supplier A Manufacturing Co.",
  "po_number": "PO-20417",
  "lines": [
    {
      "sku": "TW-BTL-750",
      "qty": 1200,
      "status": "delayed",
      "new_date": "2026-10-24",
      "date_text": "24 October",
      "note": "Ready date delayed from 10 October due to scheduled maintenance on powder-coating line; supplier offered option to split shipment"
    },
    {
      "sku": "TW-BTL-500",
      "qty": 800,
      "status": "confirmed",
      "new_date": "2026-10-10",
      "date_text": "10 October",
      "note": "Not affected; shipping as planned"
    }
  ],
  "needs_person": true,
  "needs_person_reason": "Ready date for TW-BTL-750 delayed to 24 October; supplier requires confirmation of the date and whether a split shipment is needed.",
  "reply_draft": "Hi Lily,\n\nThank you for the update on PO-20417. We note that the 800 pcs of TW-BTL-500 are on schedule to ship on 10 October, and that the 1,200 pcs of TW-BTL-750 are delayed to 24 October.\n\nI will check with our team regarding the proposed 24 October date and whether we require a split shipment, and will get back to you shortly.\n\nBest regards,\nOperations Team"
}
```

### Summary

* **PO-20460 (TW-LID-SAGE):** The supplier cannot obtain Sage green pigment in time for the 1,500 units.
* **Proposed Options:** They have offered Olive green (Pantone 5763 C) to maintain the 2 November 2026 ship date, or keeping Sage green with an estimated three-week delay.
* **Action Required:** We need to decide whether to accept the colour substitution or take the delay.

```json
{
  "supplier": "supplier-a.example",
  "po_number": "PO-20460",
  "lines": [
    {
      "sku": "TW-LID-SAGE",
      "qty": 1500,
      "status": "substitution",
      "new_date": "2026-11-02",
      "date_text": "2 November 2026",
      "note": "Supplier offered Olive green (Pantone 5763 C) to maintain the 2 November 2026 ship date; waiting for Sage green delays shipment by about three weeks."
    }
  ],
  "needs_person": true,
  "needs_person_reason": "Supplier requires a decision on whether to accept a colour substitution (Olive green) or an approximate 3-week shipment delay for Sage green.",
  "reply_draft": "Hi Lily,\n\nThank you for letting us know. We understand that due to pigment availability for PO-20460, you are offering Olive green (Pantone 5763 C) for the 1,500 pcs of TW-LID-SAGE to keep the 2 November 2026 ship date, or a delay of about three weeks if we wait for Sage green.\n\nWe will review these options with our team and get back to you as soon as possible with our decision.\n\nBest regards,\nOperations Team"
}
```
